scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend,mobile -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix mobile/mobile-app
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t atocash/manage-my-gate-server:prd1.0 -t atocash/manage-my-gate-server:latest ./backend && docker build -t atocash/manage-my-gate-client:prd1.0 -t atocash/manage-my-gate-client:latest ./frontend
